scripts.start: HOST=${HOST:-127.0.0.1}; PORT=3000; pids=$(lsof -tiTCP:$PORT -sTCP:LISTEN 2>/dev/null); if [ -n "$pids" ]; then echo "Freeing port $PORT: terminating $pids"; kill $pids 2>/dev/null || true; sleep 1; pids=$(lsof -tiTCP:$PORT -sTCP:LISTEN 2>/dev/null); if [ -n "$pids" ]; then echo "Port $PORT still busy: killing $pids"; kill -9 $pids 2>/dev/null || true; fi; fi; bun *.html pages/*.html pages/*/index.html --host=$HOST:$PORT
